ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white across approximately 70-75% of the visible fluke area, with low-intensity black pigmentation covering roughly 25-30% concentrated along the trailing edge and median notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the lateral sections of both lobes. Heavy black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge, widening significantly toward the central notch. Isolated low-intensity circular focal points are visible on the white field of the left lobe (center-left) and the right lobe (lower-right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 110-120 degrees; the vertex depth is moderately deep but partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations characterized by sharp, jagged peaks and deep valleys spanning the entire trailing edge from the notch to the tips; irregular spacing between peaks ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing margins of both lobes, transitioning to sharp, upward-tapering tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of distinct, roughly circular dark pixel clusters on the white ventral surface: one prominent spot on the left lobe and at least three smaller, faint clusters on the right lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and pronounced 'saw-tooth' serration pattern along the entire trailing edge, which is significantly more jagged than standard species morphology.
